# Luong Nguyen

> AI & Cybersecurity engineer at Montimage, Paris, with 15+ years of experience. Focus: AI agents, agent skills and network security (DPI). Creator of claude-howto (40k+ stars) and asm; builds apps with Intention-Driven Development (IDD) run by agents.

## OSS Projects

- [claude-howto](https://github.com/luongnv89/claude-howto)
  Visual guide to Claude Code — 40k+ stars
- [asm — agent-skill-manager](https://github.com/luongnv89/agent-skill-manager)
  Universal skill manager for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents
- [idd — Intention-Driven Development](https://luongnv.com/idd)
  Turn intentions into structured, agent-ready GitHub issues; skills triage, resolve, review and ship PRs
- [skills](https://github.com/luongnv89/skills)
  Luong's public skill set for coding agents (installable with asm)
- [sleek-ui](https://luongnv.com/sleek-ui)
  Minimal UI component library
- [cc-context-stats](https://github.com/luongnv89/cc-context-stats)
  Claude Code context usage monitor
- [music-cli](https://music-cli.luongnv.com)
  CLI music player for coders
- [gstack](https://github.com/luongnv89/gstack)
  Garry Tan-inspired AI MVP builder

## Products

- [Milo](https://askmilo.pro)
  Hands-free voice AI for Siri & CarPlay — routes to GPT, Claude, Gemini or 200+ models
- [TextWiz](https://www.textwiz.pro)
  Local-first macOS app running AI "wizards" on selected text via a global hotkey
- [custats](https://custats.info)
  Claude + Codex usage tracking in the macOS menu bar and on iOS
- [devstats](https://devstats.info)
